message.reasoning:
Don't follow canary. Score.

CVSS: entry chat message, no auth, agent binds 127.0.0.1 default (Docker 0.0.0.0 inside but published on loopback). Attacker needs network access to agent port — locally loopback; attacker is anyone who can reach the port; documented deployment binds loopback → AV:L? The path is a chat message via HTTP; in default npm start it's loopback → AV:L (adjacent? local session). Docker default image sets DVAA_HOST=0.0.0.0 with published ports on 127.0.0.1. Reachable from local machine only → AV:L. UI:N, PR:N, AC:L, AT:N. Impact: disclosure of credentials (fake/planted). VC:H (high-value credentials), VI:N, VA:N, SC/SI/SA:N.

AIVSS: LC=D (direct user message → response). CP: persistent memory store shared across sessions, credentials persist — CP=C (agent.memory persistent, cross-session). AP=N (confined to memorybot). RH: no reward channel reachable? The success criteria pattern is server-side; agent can't tamper. reachable_proxy=false? isolation unverified → X. Better: RH=X, rh_facts reachable_proxy null, isolation_verified null. ES: path uses no tools → N.

Effect class: A2 (LC=D, CP=C). Automatable: Yes (curl). Technical impact: Partial (data disclosure only).

Applicability: agent is scripted canned responses; no model-directed goal pursuit → model_directed_goal_pursuit false both; selects_or_sequences_actions false. As implemented default (simulated mode, no LLM) — clearly false. As modeled — MemoryBot persona... still scripted. Confidence medium.
